<h4>MapPolylineAnimation</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;MapPolylineAnimation&#8203;(@NonNull
                            <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapitemkeyframetrack" title="class in com.here.sdk.animation">MapItemKeyFrameTrack</a>&nbsp;track)
                     throws <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolylineanimation-instantiationexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.animation">MapPolylineAnimation.InstantiationException</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>Creates an animation of <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolyline" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapPolyline</code></a> based on provided keyframe track.
 Supports tracks created with <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapitemkeyframetrack" title="class in com.here.sdk.animation"><code>MapItemKeyFrameTrack</code></a> 'polylineProgress*' methods.
 For starting the animation, see <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolyline#startAnimation(com.here.sdk.animation.MapPolylineAnimation,com.here.sdk.animation.AnimationListener)"><code>MapPolyline.startAnimation(com.here.sdk.animation.MapPolylineAnimation, com.here.sdk.animation.AnimationListener)</code></a>.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>track</code> - <p>The track holding the keyframes for the animation.</dd>
<dt><span class="throwsLabel">Throws:</span></dt>
<dd><code><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolylineanimation-instantiationexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.animation">MapPolylineAnimation.InstantiationException</a></code> - <p>If the specified keyframe track cannot be used to create animation of a <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolyline" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapPolyline</code></a>.</dd>
</dl>
